lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
The federal budget watchdog wants parliamentarians to look beyond the size of the deficit when scrutinizing the Liberal government’s spending plans, The Canadian Press reports.
Ranchman’s to move into former Schanks location in south Calgary, CityNews Calgary reports.
The White House said Tuesday it has pulled the nomination of Dr, The Canadian Press reports.

Nvidia rejected Jensen Huang’s offer to return as CEO, putting to rest for now any possible reinstatement of the celebrated artificial intelligence billionaire and industry evangelist,, The Canadian Press reports.

Iran says the US military carried out several attacks on Qeshm Island in southern Iran, while at least five ships were set on fire by mines in the Strait of Hormuz earlier in the day, Euronews reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
